tools.name: get_url_html_content
tools.description: Get page HTML content Costs 1 credit per successful request.

tools.name: get_url_markdown
tools.description: Get page converted into Markdown Costs 1 credit per successful request.

tools.name: scrape_url_elements
tools.description: Scrape elements from a page by CSS selector Costs 1 credit per successful request.

tools.name: get_url_json
tools.description: Extract structured JSON from a page using AI. Provide a prompt and/or a response_format JSON schema to guide extraction. Costs 5 credits per successful extraction.

tools.name: get_url_links
tools.description: Get the list of links on a page Costs 1 credit per successful request.

tools.name: start_crawl
tools.description: Start an asynchronous crawl of a website. Returns a job_id — poll get_crawl_result to retrieve records. Workspace maximum: 100 pages and depth 5. Reserves the page limit; charges 1 credit per successful page.

tools.name: get_crawl_result
tools.description: Get the status and records of a crawl job started with start_crawl No additional credits; final crawl settlement includes partial successful pages.

tools.name: cancel_crawl
tools.description: Cancel a running crawl job No additional credits; final crawl settlement includes partial successful pages.
